replace: ring: { radius: 1, opacity: 0.9, arc: reducedMotion ? 1 : 1 - p },
killedBy: the spawn animators under reduced motion (issue #651) leaves beacon's depleting arc alone, because it is a timer rather than motion
why: The boundary of the whole issue, as a plausible over-correction rather than an omission: beacon's arc DEPLETES, so it looks like motion, but it is a timer saying how much shield is left. Calming it leaves a full ring that never moves and a player with no countdown at all -- information deleted in the name of a motion preference.
